slot_note: Re-root of task20 (architecture 1, the VaR exception classification, spent 2026-11-11: the determinism judge's isolated first pass landed nearly every result) onto the author's Concept 3 from the same concept note: a card-transaction panel's nowcast of a retailer's quarterly revenue before it reports. A new world, dataset and shell; the Quantitative Finance claim moves to Forecasting & Predictive Modeling.
niche: Alpha research (finding and validating return-predictive signals): a card-transaction panel nowcast of a home-furnishings retailer's holiday-quarter revenue three weeks before it reports, with a range that has held on past quarters
answer: short: USD 1,439.5 million (1,418.6 to 1,460.3) against the street's 1,484.0
analyst_test: The careful but hurried pass takes the licensed shops out, completes the latest weeks, keeps issuers in both years and cards of the same age, re-weights to the company's regions and turns bank-card spend into customer payments with the private-label share carried (+9.17%); it files that as net sales growth on last year's total, a beat, with a record (1.61 points) that looks sound because no past December held an event this large and no past base a contract this large.
domain_test: Nowcasting a company's reported revenue from a consumer card panel before the release, with the panel's churn, ageing cards, immature weeks and its coverage of the company's tender rebuilt so the growth index tracks revenue, and the range earned on rolling origins, is what an alternative-data research desk does to size a position into an earnings release.
layer1: weekly panel deliveries restating their latest weeks
issuer onboarding and offboarding inside the record
merchant descriptors mixing company stores, the web, licensed shop-in-shops and an acquired banner
a 4-5-4 fiscal calendar with a 53-week year
card cohorts keyed by open quarter
stakeholder_role: a consumer-sector analyst on a long-short fund's research desk, whose investment committee sizes positions into earnings releases only when the whole range clears the street's figure (not named in the prompt)

spine.entity: one row is one week's settled spend at one merchant id by one issuer's cardholders of one billing region and one card-open year
spine.grain: week x issuer x billing region x card-open year x merchant id
spine.source: simulated by task20/generator (a seeded retailer, card panel and its deliveries); no public series

world.org_type: long-short equity fund's research desk; the subject a listed home-furnishings retailer

driver: The decisive quantity is a revenue the record does not yet hold, estimated from a sample whose membership, age and coverage of the target all move, so the growth index has to be rebuilt on comparable units and its link to the target allowed to drift, and the range has to be earned on past origins that include the kind of membership change the target period carries.
driver_concrete: Like-for-like card growth at the company's regional mix and the bank cards' share of sales gives customer payments; net sales are payments less the change in customer deposits, the deposits at the quarter's end estimated from last year's by the last eight weeks' payments and made-to-order share; wholesale, which no card sees, enters at its run rate; the range from a record built at each past quarter on what was known then.
stump: A careful solver re-weights the comparable panel to the company's regions and carries the private-label card's fall, then files customer payments as net sales (USD 1,581.4 million, long): it never converts payments to revenue on delivery (the December custom orders sit in deposits at the quarter's end) and applies the panel's growth to last year's net sales, wholesale contract included; either correction alone leaves the range across the street.
results: R1 the panel's own steps to like-for-like growth (19.48%); R2 card-visible growth at the company's mix (15.00%); R3 the private-label share carried (17.00%) and customer payments (+9.17%); R4 customer deposits at the quarter's end (USD 318.9 million) and revenue on delivery (-7.33 points); R5 wholesale at its run rate (USD 17.7 million against last year's 52.5; -2.47 points); R6 the record (1.12 points over 15 quarters); R7 net sales and range (USD 1,439.5 million, 1,418.6 to 1,460.3); R8 the company steps; R9 short
one_fact_test: largest single hint (revenue on delivery with the December custom orders in deposits) rescues R4, 1 of 9

lineage.why: the determinism judge's isolated first pass (medium effort, before the answer blocks) replicated the engine, found the extracts' cutoff by reconciling product control's hypothetical P&L and executed the add-on path from the standard; the careful column priced near 95
lineage.driver: The decisive quantities are the outcomes the forecast was actually about, rebuilt from the prior holdings rather than the booked totals, and each miss's survival under counterfactual forecasts that each restore one thing production lacked (the inputs it should have read, the components it left out, a scale that follows the recent spread), with the misses charged in a fixed order so the classes add back to the whole population of misses.
